description: This Java source file defines the ShareeListAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView adapter used in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes to display sharing options, including user, group, email, and link shares. It manages different view types for various share items, handles adding, updating, and removing shares, and sorts shares based on creation time and type.

classes.name: ShareeListAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying sharing options in Nextcloud Notes Android client, supporting different share types and managing share items.

methods.name: ShareeListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with activity context, share list, listener, and account, and performing initial sorting.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for a share item based on its share type.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder based on share type for display.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds share data to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for a share item.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of share items.

methods.name: addShares
methods.description: Adds a list of shares, removing duplicates, sorts, and refreshes display.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific share from the list.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Clears all shares from the list.

methods.name: addShare
methods.description: Adds a new share at the top of the list.

methods.name: updateShare
methods.description: Updates an existing share based on its ID.

methods.name: sortShares
methods.description: Sorts shares by creation time, prioritizing email and link shares.

methods.name: getShares
methods.description: Returns the current list of shares.

methods.name: removeNewPublicShare
methods.description: Removes any share of type NEW_PUBLIC_LINK.
